WITH AllMarketplaceReturns AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ir.return_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        ir.sales_channel AS marketplace_name,
        ir.return_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_returns ir
    WHERE
        ir.group_level_id = '22'
        AND ir.is_active = true
        AND ir.return_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', mr.return_date) AS month_start_date, -- Inferred date field
        'Meesho' AS marketplace_name,
        mr.return_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.meesho_returns mr
    WHERE
        mr.group_level_id = '22'
        AND mr.is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND mr.return_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter, assuming similar status to Increff
)
SELECT
    month_start_date,
    marketplace_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT return_id) AS total_returns
FROM
    AllMarketplaceReturns
GROUP BY
    month_start_date,
    marketplace_name
ORDER BY
    month_start_date, marketplace_name;
